training_use_carve_out.required_evidence: signed terms expressly excluding customer and Blueprint content from provider model training, testing, development, and improvement

confidential_processing_and_dpa.observed: The live DPA describes Varjo as processor, confidentiality, written instructions, subprocessors, and security controls.
confidential_processing_and_dpa.required_evidence: executed DPA and enterprise terms whose confidentiality and processing purpose control over the standard Terms training license

retention_and_deletion.observed: The API returns only 204 for deletion; the DPA promises deletion or return within a reasonable time on termination or expiry but publishes no capture-level retention schedule or durable deletion receipt.
retention_and_deletion.required_evidence: contractual retention schedule, backup and subprocessor deletion terms, and durable deletion attestation or auditable equivalent

transferable_exportable_model_rights.observed: The standard Terms permit use of generated Models but describe the license as non-assignable and non-transferable and restrict integration without prior written consent.
transferable_exportable_model_rights.required_evidence: written transferable, sublicensable, export, integration, benchmarking, and customer-delivery rights

derivative_blueprint_site_package_rights.required_evidence: written right to preserve, modify, align, combine, derive, distribute, sublicense, and commercialize Blueprint site-package artifacts from exported models

enterprise_or_on_prem_known_sensor_inges.observed: The public API documents RGB image ZIP or video input. The pricing page advertises enterprise cloud and on-prem deployment but does not document endpoints for known poses, intrinsics, depth, LiDAR, or gravity.
enterprise_or_on_prem_known_sensor_inges.required_evidence: provider technical specification and qualified endpoint proof for each claimed modality: known poses, intrinsics, depth, LiDAR, and gravity
